info.title: NEXUS API Contracts
info.description: F03 contract catalog generated from the shared Zod schemas. No F03 HTTP controller is implemented; these components are declared and frozen for later API route-owning phases.

servers.description: Declared browser API base path; controllers begin in later phases

get.summary: Obtain a preauth challenge or rotate a session CSRF token

403.description: Session CSRF refresh origin is not allowed

post.summary: Consume a single-use preauth challenge and create an eight-hour session

403.description: Origin, CSRF or role check failed

get.summary: Read the authenticated identity and roles

200.description: Identity and roles only (no sandbox context)

get.summary: List persisted cases in the active sandbox

post.summary: Accept a case intake event into the durable queue

202.description: Case and case-created event persisted for queued delivery

400.description: Invalid body, header or actor role

403.description: Operator role, origin or CSRF check failed

409.description: Idempotency key or source identity was reused with a different body

get.summary: Read a workflow run and its step summary

404.description: Run not found in the active sandbox

409.description: No active sandbox or stale resource scope

get.summary: Read a bounded page of persisted run events

400.description: Invalid run ID, cursor or limit

404.description: Run not found in the active sandbox

409.description: No active sandbox or stale resource scope

get.summary: Stream persisted run events with Last-Event-ID replay
get.description: SSE frames use id/event/data with event=step|status|text_delta|final|error. The 15-second heartbeat is a comment and is not stored. Disconnect does not cancel the run.

400.description: Invalid run ID, cursor or Last-Event-ID

404.description: Run not found in the active sandbox

409.description: No active sandbox or stale resource scope

post.summary: Resume a persisted workflow wait with an explicit cause

200.description: Run queued from the matching wait

400.description: Invalid run ID or resume request

403.description: Operator role, origin or CSRF check failed

404.description: Run not found in the active sandbox

409.description: Terminal, illegal, duplicate or unsupported wake

400.description: Invalid run ID or cancel cause

403.description: Operator role, origin or CSRF check failed

404.description: Run not found in the active sandbox

get.summary: Read a case in the active sandbox

404.description: Case not found in the active sandbox

get.summary: Read redacted append-only history for a case

404.description: Case not found in the active sandbox

get.summary: Read immutable evidence in the active sandbox

200.description: Evidence snapshot or explicitly missing source

404.description: Evidence not found in the active sandbox

post.summary: Create a manually submitted action proposal revision for a case

201.description: Persisted immutable pending revision or idempotent replay

400.description: Invalid proposal draft, header or unsupported action kind

403.description: Operator role, origin or CSRF check failed

404.description: Case not found in the active sandbox

409.description: Idempotency mismatch or an open procurement plan already exists

503.description: Proposal storage or policy bundle unavailable

get.summary: List current proposal revisions for a case

404.description: Case not found in the active sandbox

get.summary: Read the current immutable proposal revision

404.description: Proposal not found in the active sandbox

patch.summary: Supersede the whole pending or approved unexecuted revision

200.description: New revision with a fully recomputed hash and roles

400.description: Invalid edit or missing If-Match precondition

403.description: Operator role, origin or CSRF check failed

404.description: Proposal not found in the active sandbox

409.description: Stale revision or open procurement conflict

503.description: Proposal storage or policy bundle unavailable

x-nexus-implementation-status.httpControllers: auth, case reads, durable case intake, proposal create/edit/read, run control and run read/SSE
x-nexus-implementation-status.openapiPaths: auth, sandbox, case/evidence reads, case intake, proposal create/edit/read, run control, run detail/event pages and persisted SSE; later controllers are declared in their owner stages
